messages:
natalie: Heads-up — ThermalCo just pushed the H100 tranche ETA out by ~3 weeks. Depot flagged a potential customs hold that could add 3–5 business days. We need a call on split vs single shipment and what we pay for expedite.

omar: Ugh. eu-west is at ~65% GPU committed for next 2w. If we stagger shipments we can avoid starving Dedicated pools, but it's riskier for customers with pinned versions.

luca: Can we top up from apac spare pool? I know we have ~8 H100s in sg-staging that could be reallocated, but that creates cross-region egress & tax headaches.

thermalco-sales: hi team — sorry for the churn. Options: (A) split shipment (2/3 now, 1/3 delayed) with no extra expedite fee; (B) single consolidated air with +8% freight & +$1,200 expedite surcharge; (C) reroute to FRA hub (adds 2d transit, removes customs risk). AWB for current booking: CGK1234567890. RMA for DOA handling: thermal-RMA-std v2 (30d SLA).

supply-bot: Procurement alert: vendor ThermalCo reported port congestion on 2025-06-18. Estimated leadtime variance +21 days. See internal ticket #PR-6182.

kai: Prioritization ask — private/regulatory customers and dedicated enterprise with SLAs must be first. If we do split, hold back 4 units for those.

amanda-ps: We should push back on the $1,200 expedite. That was not in the original SOW; suggest we offer to pay half if they can guarantee customs docs pre-cleared.

omar: Ops note — if we accept split, update routing policy to prefer local-quantized model variants for any capacity gap. Reduce SLO exposure by routing extra inference to lower-latency hosted pool.

luca: Re allocation — if apac covers 6 of the 8 spares, we can spare 2 for eu pin-reserves. Egress/tax will need finance signoff.

thermalco-sales: We can pre-clear docs for FRA hub option. For expedite fee we can absorb $700 if Redwood covers the remaining $500. We can also include complimentary RMA 'hot-swap' labels for depot returns (reduces repair turnaround).

natalie: Proposed plan: 1) Hold 4 units for private/dedicated (kai) 2) Move 6 units from SG staging to FRA hub (luca + finance) 3) Accept split shipment for remainder with ThermalCo absorbing $700 expedite; Redwood covers $500 if finance approves. 4) ThermalCo to send pre-clear docs by EOD.

amanda-ps: I'll ping finance now for the $500 approval — estimate impact to Q2 margin ~0.04%.

omar: I'll update routing policies and canary rules to avoid pinned-model failures — will push a temporary fallback to hosted variants.

thermalco-sales: Thanks — sending docs now. AWB update will be posted once FRA rebook is confirmed.

natalie: Perfect. Action items noted. If docs don't land by EOD I’ll escalate to account exec. :thumbsup:
